name: Intimidation
overview: Scripture teaches that believers facing intimidation are called to be strong and courageous, trusting in the Lord who will never fail or forsake them. God's protection and deliverance are assured for those who love Him and know His name, providing help from the Creator of heaven and earth. Though enemies may gather against God's people, they will ultimately fall for the believer's sake, and knowing the truth of God’s promises brings freedom from fear.
